title: Browser game use cases
description: What a player does with the page, step by step.

entities.name: Play a game of Lundey
entities.description: A player starts a game, clears what burrows they can, and leaves a best score on the device.
entities.goal: Clear as many burrows as they can, and beat the best score kept on this device.
preconditions: The page is open: the Worker serves it only to a signed-in player who holds games:lundey (games/lundey/worker).
The title screen is showing, or the demo it plays when left alone.
postconditions: The game is over, and the title screen comes back.
If the score passed the best kept on this device, the new best is saved in the browser and shown as BEST.

flow.action: Shows the title screen, with the best score read from the browser.
Presses Enter or Space, taps the screen, or presses PLAY or the gamepad's A.
Starts a game on burrow 1 with three puffins, and counts in.
Points the puffin with the arrow keys or WASD, a swipe, the on-screen cross or the gamepad, and pauses when they like.
Steps the game sixty times a second with the step's controls, draws each frame at the screen's own resolution, and plays a sound for each event.
Goes on to the next burrow when one is cleared and to the next puffin when one is caught, and saves the best score if it has grown, each time a puffin is caught, a burrow is cleared or the game ends.
Shows GAME OVER and the score when the last puffin is caught, then the title screen again after five seconds, or a new game on a start press.

alternatives.condition: Nobody starts a game for twelve seconds.
alternatives.outcome: The page starts a demo that the autopilot plays, without sound and without touching the best score. A start press begins a real game; otherwise the demo ends when its puffin is caught or its burrow cleared, and the title screen comes back.

alternatives.condition: The browser refuses storage, as a private window may.
alternatives.outcome: The best score starts at 0 and a new best is not kept; the game plays as usual.

alternatives.condition: The tab is hidden during the count-in or play.
alternatives.outcome: The page queues a pause, taken on the next step. The game waits, paused, until the player presses pause again.

alternatives.condition: The page was held up for more than a quarter of a second.
alternatives.outcome: Only a quarter of a second of steps is made up; the rest of the time is dropped, so the game never races to catch up.
